name: project_creator
description: Generate a complete multi-file software project (not a single file) — pass a full folder structure and file contents, get back one zip download. Use this instead of file_generation when the request needs more than one file (an app, a backend, a component library, anything with real project structure). Every Python file is syntax-checked before packaging; the response tells you if any failed.

project_name.description: Name for the project. Used as the zip filename (e.g. 'expense-tracker' -> 'expense-tracker.zip').

files.description: Every file in the project. Each item: {"path": "relative/path/to/file.ext", "content": "full file text"}. Use real relative paths with folders (e.g. 'src/components/Header.jsx', not just 'Header.jsx') to preserve project structure in the zip.

entrypoint.description: Path to the main runnable Python file (e.g. 'main.py'), if this project should actually be executed as part of validation, not just syntax-checked. Optional — omit for non-Python or non-runnable projects (e.g. a static HTML site).
